values.wall.education.questions.0.title: What does Premium include?
values.wall.education.questions.0.answer: Your subscription includes Premium courses, World Tours, Training Programs, Dynamic Plan activation, AI insights and eligible challenges while your membership is active.
values.wall.education.questions.1.title: Is AI Coach unlimited?
values.wall.education.questions.1.answer: Free and Premium both have a finite conversation allowance. Your first Premium subscription gives you fresh allowance immediately. Your training features remain available if that allowance is used up.
values.wall.education.questions.2.title: Can I turn off renewal?
values.wall.education.questions.2.answer: You can turn off auto-renewal in subscription settings. Your Premium access continues until the end of your current paid period.
